answer: A sybil farm thrives where identities are cheap to keep alive, so make dormancy a tundra: an identity's locked rewards thaw only in epochs where it both answers and serves a jury seat dealt at random from outside its funding cluster. Each grade is checked against a later crystal-clear reveal, so copied or coordinated scores surface as correlated misses. Past a ridge of a few dozen identities sharing infrastructure, seats per cluster stop scaling, so extra clones add cost but no voice.
